name: United Arab Emirates
interpretation: High purchasing power. K-beauty/K-culture popular. Gateway to broader GCC market.

name: United States
interpretation: Not a new market entry - focus is channel expansion and SKU diversification across offline retail.
market_role: Core market - sell-through and channel expansion priority

name: Brazil
interpretation: 5th largest beauty market globally. Massive long-term potential but high regulatory and operational barriers.

name: United Kingdom
interpretation: English-language market allows reuse of US marketing assets. Good initial test market for Europe.
market_role: Core Europe - competitive market, account growth priority

name: Germany
interpretation: Derma skincare culture aligns with Medicube positioning. EU regulatory approval is a gateway to broader Europe.
market_role: Core Europe - competitive market, differentiation required

name: Poland
interpretation: K-beauty import growth accelerating. Lower competition and entry cost than Western EU. Potential test market for Eastern European expansion.
market_role: Secondary Europe - whitespace test market (domestic channels unverified)

name: France
interpretation: Beauty powerhouse but brand trust barrier is high. Clinical/derma messaging must be polished for sophisticated consumers.
market_role: Core Europe - premium channel present, editorial visibility gap

name: Spain
interpretation: K-beauty import growth rising. Untapped potential at accessible price points. APR has existing distributor relationship.

name: Kazakhstan
interpretation: CIS gateway with less sanctions risk than Russia. Growing middle class and K-culture popularity. Long-term strategic bet.
market_role: CIS - marketplace-led market, channel control needed
